query:
SELECT p.kind, count(*) AS "places!",
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.n >= 2) AS "merged!"
        FROM places p
        JOIN (SELECT place_id, count(*) AS n FROM place_sources GROUP BY place_id) n
          ON n.place_id = p.id
        WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
        GROUP BY p.kind ORDER BY count(*) DESC
